title: Structural Buckling Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
t: Structural Buckling Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
description: Predicts linear and nonlinear buckling loads and modes of structures.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Predicts linear and nonlinear buckling loads and modes of structures. A structural buckling analysis tool computes linear eigenvalue buckling loads and traces nonlinear post-buckling paths with arc-length methods, including imperfection sensitivity. Real implementations live in FEA suites (Abaqus, Nastran, CalculiX) and shell-specific tools. It applies knockdown factors per NASA SP-8007 for shells and validates against test.
capabilities: Linear eigenvalue buckling for modes and load factors

title: Structural Buckling Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Structural Buckling Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Predicts linear and nonlinear buckling loads and modes of structures.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Structural Buckling Analysis Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Linear eigenvalue buckling for modes and load factors). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Linear eigenvalue buckling for modes and load factors and Nonlinear Riks arc-length post-buckling analysis. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Finite Element Analysis (FEA) program) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
capabilities: Linear eigenvalue buckling for modes and load factors
